notes.v1_02: Hat Box: Light the box from the upper left so the right third of the red drum turns clearly darker, and make the navy lid top slightly brighter than its side band. Give the red sides a soft matte paper-board finish with a slightly darker contact shadow at the base. Keep the shape, the rope handle and the green backdrop.
notes.v1_09: Pearl Necklace: Replace the dark tufted velvet with a smooth, softly shaded satin cushion in a warm dusty rose, with no buttons and no fibre fuzz, a little lighter overall. Light the pearls from the upper left, with one small soft highlight each and slightly darker lower-right pearls. Keep the bracelet, the gold clasp and the top-down view.
notes.v1_07: Cake Stand: Make the back wall a light lilac with soft, gentle stripes in place of the dark purple. Make the tablecloth plain smooth white fabric with no visible weave. Slightly darken the undersides of the plates and give the stand a satin finish with highlights only on the rims. Keep the stand, the cakes and the table corner.
notes.v1_08: Steamer Trunk: Replace the grey cracked flagstones and the yellow strip with a few large, smooth, warm sandy stone slabs with soft faint joints. Paint the wood as smooth red-brown with faint quiet grain. Make the straps plain leather bands with no stitching or punched holes. Keep the trunk, the brass corners, the buckles and the blue rays.
notes.v1_10: Rock Guitar: Paint the piano as smooth satin red-brown wood with faint quiet grain and highlights only on the top edges, in place of glossy lacquered grain. Make the wall a soft plain blue-grey with a faint pattern, in place of the cream damask. Make the floor matte honey wood with soft, faint reflections. Keep the piano, the keys, the pedals and the view.
